# Everything about the event “Das Rad” / The Wheel (Nuka World on Tour Update)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_83_nukaknights-post-event-spin-the-wheel.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**[Update March 18, 2023]** Overview map for “Find the golden corks”

This event is one of the new 4 public events that will be released free of charge as an update for Fallout 76 with the Nuka World on Tour update on December 6th, 2022.

## Process

“The Wheel” is a kind of “wheel of fortune” event. The event takes place under a circus tent in "Nuka World on Tour". There, in the middle of the ring, is the wheel on which every lap is turned. Every round the goal is “rolled” anew. To do this, one player goes to the wheel and turns it using the button in front of it as soon as it lights up red.

![](/uploads/20221014010007-1.jpg)

When the event shows up you have **4 minutes** to get to the stage in the circus tent.

As soon as you are on stage, Flaschi and Korki will explain the rules to you, then you have **30 seconds** to press the **button on the wheel** for the first time.

![](/uploads/20221014010024-1.jpg)

As soon as the wheel has stopped, the respective **round** starts with a new timer that is set depending on the round. The task for this round must be completed within this time.

There are 3 different colored areas on the wheel, depending on the color there are different rounds:

- **Red**
Boss fight rounds with 60 seconds time
- **Blue**
Hordes rounds of “crowd control” with various opponents
- **Yellow**
Random challenges e.g. Find golden corks

There are different options for each round:

- **Find the golden corks**
30 seconds
- **Destroy the Vim-nata!**
30 seconds: Find and destroy Vim machines (Tip: It's usually outside the tent)
- **Find the Korki Trickster!**
30 seconds to find the wrong Korki on the grandstand (tip: it makes noises)
- **Catch the chickens!**
30 seconds to catch the chickens
- **Time for a Twist**
30 seconds: Move or explode!
- **Push the Brahmin!**
30 seconds to push the Brahmins
- **Avoid the explosive deer!**
30 seconds
- **Crowd Control**
 1 minute: Fight wave with different opponents:
 - Ghouls and Stingwings
 - RAD toads and creepers
 - Ghouls and floaters
 - Mirelurks and Aggressotrons
 - Angler and Mr. Gutsy
 - Mirelurks and Mr. Gutsy
 - Robobrains and blood beetles
 - RAD toad and super mutants
 - Super mutants and honey beast
 - Snallygaster and Floater
 - Anglers and RAD rats
 - Ghouls and ants
 - Floaters and bees
 - Snallygaster and Eyebots
- **Boss Beatdown**
 1 minute to kill level 100 enemies:
 - Super Mutant Behemoth
 - Mistcrawler
 - Monsters of Grafton
 - Deathclaws
 - Sheepsquatch

After completing each round, you again have **30 seconds** to press your head and start the **next round**.

There are **5 rounds** in total until the event is completed.

The objectives apply to all rounds:

- Defend the red mascot
- Defend the blue mascot
- Defend the yellow mascot

Similar to other events, these 3 mascot statues may not be destroyed.

![](/uploads/20221014010223-1.jpg)

![](/uploads/20221014010628-1.jpg)
